claims.title: Common damping transform and exact energy
claims.scope: conditional derived mathematical theorem for report and native implementation design
claims.reason: Cubic homogeneity gives exp(-2*kappa*t) nonlinear weight. Weighted energy cancels the real part of the imaginary collective force, gives global finite-dimensional existence, and preserves all independent initial data.
claims.material_premises_and_limits: Declared common damping/frequency, positive normalized weights, real chi; not heterogeneous damping.

claims.title: Uniform-kappa homotopy coefficient convergence
claims.scope: conditional derived mathematical theorem for report and native implementation design
claims.reason: Weighted l1 of continuous-function coefficients is a Banach algebra; formal/real coefficient conjugation is isometric. DW6 gives an actual self-map and contraction; coefficient tail gives DW7. Induction yields degree <=(3ell+1)p+ell and exponent index <=ell.
claims.material_premises_and_limits: Strict ball and contraction margins, exact descriptor; all evaluator/representation errors charged. No holomorphy of |u|^2u in complex time is asserted.

claims.material_premises_and_limits: Nonnegative integer degrees, a,t>=0; interval scalar evaluator remains to implement, and cancellation may force more precision.

findings.original_issue: Unprojected shared reconstruction was claimed identical to arbitrary projected full profile.
findings.counterexample: D=0, constant forcing, Pi=degree-0 truncation: projected profile remains initial constant; unprojected output has a linear-in-time forcing term.
findings.resolution: Same-map endpoint applies Pi to free profile and shared integrals; unprojected original-target reconstruction is a distinct output.

findings.original_issue: Common integration-weight preparation could be conflated with application cost.
findings.resolution: Preparation alone may cancel; actual applications counted. Comparator lower bound skips multiplication by one; additions also counted.

findings.original_issue: Multi-output upper bound charged per-mode output but omitted repeated shared ordinary scalar coefficient setup.
findings.resolution: Adds R_out*(p+1)*(Q+1)*(D+1)^2 plus total evaluator cost over all outputs; strict gate includes these costs.

findings.original_issue: n*p loses mandatory O(n) work at admitted p=0.
findings.resolution: Input/reconstruction and per-output terms now n*(p+1).
